_: How each DLL bundle on system-libraries-v1 is built from the vendor's package (tools/bundles/build.py). 'sources': the packages (url + md5 from the Bottles dependency manifests at bottlesdevs/dependencies 8dd62af0, 2026-06-23; 'open': installer = DroidDeck's unpacker). 'files': from = <source name>:<glob inside the opened package, nested cabinets appear as <name>.opened/>, to = path in the bundle. The result must equal the hand-made bundle file for file (expect.json).
